source.name: Druid
source.description:
Druid pieces will not be destroyed on a ★★★ piece combined.

CLASS PERK: Synergy
 Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this class on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Druids: Two identical Druid★ can promote to a Druid★★.
(4) Druids: Two identical Druid★★ can promote to a Druid★★★.
(6) Druids: Two identical Druid★★★ can promote to the great Altar of Spirits♥♥♥, and gain several(equal to the level of Druid★★★) stack of Altar Power, and destroy all Druid pieces in the chess pool.
